# Chandtara Infra Private Limited

> Official website and comprehensive corporate profile of Chandtara Infra Private Limited (CIN: U42209BR2026PTC088206), a premier multi-disciplinary infrastructure and civil engineering firm headquartered in Gopalganj, Bihar, India.

Chandtara Infra Private Limited is duly incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India. The company delivers high-precision civil engineering, state and national highway construction, bridge & culvert engineering, commercial & residential building construction, rooftop & ground-mounted solar power plants, municipal water pipeline networks, and heavy machinery logistics across Bihar and Eastern India.

## Core Business Verticals (MOA Clause 3(a))

1. **Civil Engineering & Building Construction**:
   Turnkey residential houses, apartments, commercial multi-story plazas, modern warehouses, industrial sheds, institutional buildings, structural renovation, and architectural finishing.

2. **Roads, Bridges & Heavy Infrastructure**:
   Bituminous and concrete highways, rural PMGSY roadways, bridges, flyovers, expressways, culverts, drainage channels, retaining walls, and earth embankments.

3. **Solar Energy & Renewable Power Projects**:
   On-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar installations, commercial rooftop arrays, utility-scale ground-mounted solar farms, solar irrigation pumping systems, and EPC operations.

4. **Pipelines & Municipal Water Supply Networks**:
   Drinking water pipeline distribution (Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal), high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and ductile iron (DI) pipe laying, overhead water tanks (ESR), deep tube-wells, and sewage drainage networks.

5. **Real Estate & Modern Colony Development**:
   Land acquisition, master layout development, residential plotting, gated township infrastructure, paved internal roads, drainage, and street electrification.

6. **Construction Materials & Heavy Plant Machinery Logistics**:
   Bulk supply of verified cement, TMT rebars, blue metal aggregates, coarse sand, ready-mix concrete (RMC), and leasing of excavators (JCB), transit mixers, cranes, and tippers.

7. **Civil AMC & Structural Maintenance**:
   Comprehensive building repairs, structural retrofitting, industrial waterproofing, concrete crack injection, expansion joint treatments, and annual maintenance contracts.

8. **Agro-Infrastructure & Cold Chain Facilities**:
   Design and construction of multi-commodity cold storage units, controlled atmosphere storage, food grain silos, and agricultural processing hubs.

9. **Skill Development & Technical Training**:
   Vocational skill development centers for masons, bar-benders, electricians, solar technicians, and heavy equipment operators.
